name: example-pricing-spring-tiers
title: Spring Tiers Pricing
description: A pricing page with a breathing first viewport — staggered tier-card reveals loop gently forever, a real spring-damped monthly/yearly toggle self-flips on a timer, and the recommended tier pulses with a velocity-driven skew — while staying a fully scannable SaaS pricing template with a comparison table and FAQ.
credits: Reveal-stagger contract and named easing tokens structurally inspired by darkroomengineering/satus (MIT); original vanilla JS/CSS motion, no GSAP/Lenis source.

useCase.query: A pricing page whose first viewport breathes: staggered tier-card reveals loop as a slow breathing cycle, a real spring-damped monthly/yearly toggle self-flips on a timer, and the recommended tier pulses with a velocity-driven skew — full comparison table and FAQ included. Use when the brief asks for "pricing", "plans", "subscription tiers", a "compare plans" page, or wants continuous, tasteful motion on a pricing screen instead of a static layout.
